name: Noah
source:
A troubled, seemingly apathetic boy suffering from a weird and mysterious memory loss.
He has vague general knowledge about the world around him, such as his surroundings or famous brands, but has no memories of himself.
Every now and then, something rings a bell.
Oscillating between dissociation and some sort of blurred lucidity, he tries to find out who or what’s hiding behind his forgotten identity.
